interpretation: Each variant has two fresh processes and six samples per repeated action. P95 is the largest of six samples and is not a final twenty-repetition estimate. No OS cache flush. Foreground IPC includes transport and body reads; elapsed minus its interval union includes UI/render/frame/wait time, not pure paint. Background note polls remain in raw elapsed and are reported separately.

pilot_gate.interpretation: Pilot continuation gate only; final source acceptance still needs the charter gates and matrix.
